summary: Cresud Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of Series LII and LIII notes in the Argentine local capital markets totaling approximately USD 64.2 million. The Series LII notes amount to USD 41.2 million at 4.75% due April 2028, and Series LIII notes amount to USD 23.0 million at 6.25% due April 2030, both at 100% face value with bullet principal at maturity. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report of a note offering, not subject to special-situation analysis.
